items.title: Dashboards run with the analyst's warehouse credentials, so viewers inherit the analyst's access
Anyone holding a shared dashboard link can read salary and health-plan rows
Row-level data for salary and health tables is published with no row-level restriction per viewer
Any employee with a link can trigger unbounded warehouse queries, running up cost and starving other jobs
Links that never expire keep working for leavers and after role changes
Access to health and salary data is attributed to the analyst, not the viewer
